thread:
leah: Heads-up — EdgeVault replied to our vendor intake. They attached a filled CAIQ and a SOC2 summary. Need quick risk read and whether we can greenlight a POC with ephemeral access. Link: https://edgevault.example/caiq-attachment (pdf)

dmitri: On it. Do we already have their subprocessor list? that'll drive data residency/contract asks.

leah: Not in the intake. CAIQ mentions AWS + FastCDN as subprocessors. No DPA attached.

samir: Can we run a short checklist? Key items: encryption at rest, key management, customer-managed KMS support, breach notif SLA, pen test date, SOC2 scope. If they don't support CMK, POC must use anonymized data.

mara: I skimmed the CAIQ — encryption at rest yes (AES-256), KMS used but looks like vendor-managed. Pen test from 11/2024, no attestation copy in the intake.

oliver: Asking for SOC2 report copy now. Also flagging that EdgeVault's POC requires uploading small customer data for model prompt routing — that's an enterprise blocker unless we have a DPA + subprocessors sign-off.

leah: For sales — ask them to provide ephemeral API key for POC with strict rate limits and IP allowlist. Also ask for a scoped test org with isolated data retention (30d) and data purge endpoint.

vendor-intake-bot: New document added to intake ticket #VND-1983 — CAIQ received, status: awaiting evidence.

dmitri: Proposed immediate mitigations if they can't provide SOC2 copy: 1) limit POC to synthetic/anonymized data, 2) require encrypted blobs with customer-side encryption, 3) short retention window and audit logs pushed to our S3.

samir: Score from quick triage: medium risk due to missing DPA + SOC2 evidence. Recommend conditional POC only with the mitigations above and legal loop-in for DPA negotiation.

mara: One more: confirm whether they support customer-managed keys (CMK). If not, legal will want indemnity language for key compromise.

leah: I'll ask for: SOC2 report, DPA draft or yes/no, full subprocessor list, CMK support, pen-test report PDF, and ephemeral API key for POC. Target reply by EOD PT. @dmitri can you prepare the short POC security checklist I can send to the sales rep?

dmitri: Yup, I'll drop a 1‑page checklist in thread in 30m. It will include the exact scoping language and required endpoints (purge, webhook audits, HMAC signing for callbacks).

oliver: FYI sales rep asked about pricing concession for the POC. We'll only allow pricing concessions if legal approves DPA terms and risk team signs off. Put that in the ask to sales.

samir: Also flag for PSC: potential need for a temporary network isolation if they require VPN access — that increases SRE involvement.

leah: Great. I'll compile asks and ping the sales rep. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
